Author: Stwohm (fork of yagi2/Restocker)
Name: Restocky
Changelog: 0.3.14.0 — Stock tracking: select several items and restock them in one run (Select low, Restock selected). Auto-restock now also works during AutoRetainer visits, one retainer at a time. [Match price] chat link and Reprice tab button for prices blocked by Max drop or Max raise: one-shot, tied to the price you reviewed. Market searches no longer collide with the previous item's results: they wait, retry on "Please wait and try your search again.", and finish sooner when no rival is listed. Market sale history that arrives late is kept.
Punchline: Restocker fork: bulk reprice with price guards, sales tracking and an optional bell auto-cycle.
Description: Personal fork of yagi2/Restocker. Reprice every retainer listing to the live market lowest -N gil with floor / max-drop guards, track each listing until it sells (reprices, competitors, days, gil), one-click full cycle and an optional timed auto-cycle at the summoning bell that waits for AutoRetainer. Timed automation is against the FFXIV ToS; use at your own risk.
